findings.label: Unpacking error in multi-image worker
findings.description: Line 1140 calls `await _ocr_image(contents, content_type)` and assigns to `extracted_text` without unpacking the cost tuple. The function returns `tuple[str, float]` but only one value is assigned. This will raise `ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 1)` on the second and subsequent images in any multi-image batch.

findings.label: Cost not logged per-image in multi-image worker
findings.description: The single-image worker logs each vision call to AiUsageLog, but the multi-image worker does not log per-image costs. The multi-image design merges multiple images into one StudyMaterial, but the neural cost tracking should still capture all vision API calls. At minimum, unpack the cost tuple to match the function signature; optionally accumulate and log total cost across the batch.
